steps.data:
/*
Theme Name: Brine
Theme URI: https://github.com/richtabor/chatgpt-agent-woo-builder
Author: Brine
Author URI: https://example.com/brine
Description: A fermentation-first WooCommerce theme built around starter rituals, pantry depth, and giftable live-flavor systems. Editorial serif headlines on a warm rice-paper surface, with deep-cellar dark sections for subscription and editorial moments.
Version: 1.0.0
Requires at least: 6.4
Tested up to: 6.6
Requires PHP: 7.4
License: GPL v2 or later
License URI: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
Text Domain: brine
Tags: full-site-editing, block-patterns, woocommerce
*/

<?php
// Brine product importer — uses WC's public WC_Product_Simple API.
// Reads /wp-content/uploads/brine-products.csv (10-column Brine schema)
// and creates products + product_cat terms idempotently by SKU.

if ( ! function_exists( 'wc_get_product_id_by_sku' ) ) {
    echo 'WooCommerce not loaded — aborting Brine import.' . PHP_EOL;
    return;
}

$csv_file = '/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/brine-products.csv';
if ( ! file_exists( $csv_file ) ) {
    echo 'Brine CSV not found at ' . $csv_file . PHP_EOL;
    return;
}

$handle = fopen( $csv_file, 'r' );
if ( ! $handle ) {
    echo 'Could not open Brine CSV.' . PHP_EOL;
    return;
}

$header = fgetcsv( $handle );
if ( ! $header ) {
    echo 'Brine CSV has no header row.' . PHP_EOL;
    fclose( $handle );
    return;
}

$created = 0;
$skipped = 0;
$failed  = 0;

while ( ( $row = fgetcsv( $handle ) ) !== false ) {
    if ( count( $row ) < count( $header ) ) {
        $row = array_pad( $row, count( $header ), '' );
    }
    $r = array_combine( $header, $row );
    if ( empty( $r['SKU'] ) || empty( $r['Name'] ) ) {
        $skipped++;
        continue;
    }
    if ( wc_get_product_id_by_sku( $r['SKU'] ) ) {
        $skipped++;
        continue;
    }

    try {
        $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
        $product->set_name( (string) $r['Name'] );
        $product->set_status( ( '1' === (string) $r['Published'] || 'yes' === strtolower( (string) $r['Published'] ) ) ? 'publish' : 'draft' );
        $product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
        $product->set_description( (string) $r['Description'] );
        $product->set_short_description( (string) $r['Short description'] );
        $product->set_sku( (string) $r['SKU'] );
        if ( '' !== trim( (string) $r['Regular price'] ) ) {
            $product->set_regular_price( (string) $r['Regular price'] );
        }

        if ( ! empty( $r['Categories'] ) ) {
            $term_ids = array();
            foreach ( array_map( 'trim', explode( ',', $r['Categories'] ) ) as $segment_path ) {
                if ( '' === $segment_path ) {
                    continue;
                }
                $segments = array_map( 'trim', explode( '>', $segment_path ) );
                $parent   = 0;
                $term_id  = 0;
                foreach ( $segments as $segment ) {
                    if ( '' === $segment ) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $existing = get_term_by( 'name', $segment, 'product_cat' );
                    if ( $existing && (int) $existing->parent === (int) $parent ) {
                        $term_id = (int) $existing->term_id;
                    } else {
                        $insert = wp_insert_term( $segment, 'product_cat', array( 'parent' => $parent ) );
                        if ( is_wp_error( $insert ) ) {
                            $existing = get_term_by( 'name', $segment, 'product_cat' );
                            $term_id  = $existing ? (int) $existing->term_id : 0;
                        } else {
                            $term_id = (int) $insert['term_id'];
                        }
                    }
                    $parent = $term_id;
                }
                if ( $term_id ) {
                    $term_ids[] = $term_id;
                }
            }
            if ( $term_ids ) {
                $product->set_category_ids( array_values( array_unique( $term_ids ) ) );
            }
        }

        $product_id = $product->save();
        if ( $product_id ) {
            $created++;
        } else {
            $failed++;
        }
    } catch ( Exception $e ) {
        $failed++;
        echo 'Failure for SKU ' . $r['SKU'] . ': ' . $e->getMessage() . PHP_EOL;
    }
}
fclose( $handle );

echo sprintf( 'Brine import complete: created=%d skipped=%d failed=%d', $created, $skipped, $failed ) . PHP_EOL;
